The list of websites below are the modalities that I have had training in. I highly encourage any LMT, PT, athletic trainer or chiropractor to check these sites out for their Continuing Education programs. Most of these websites have lists of therapists in your area. So, you can put in your zip code and find a therapist near you to try out.

Paul Kelly, Physiokinetix, www.templehp.com
Eric Dalton, Myoskeletal, www.erikdalton.com
James Waslaski, Orthopedic Massage, www.orthomassage.net
Michael Young, Megan Sanders, R.U.I.T., www.mrtherapy.com
Oleg Bouimer, Russian Sports Massage, www.russiansportsmassage.com
Anatomy Trains, Continuing Educational Classes, www.anatomytrains.com
Rocktape, Continuing Educational Classes, www.rocktape.com
FMS, Functional Movement Classes, www.functionalmovement.com
Darryl (DJ) Amadio, Continuing Educational Classes, www.darryl-amadio.square.site
